stories.title: The 21-Year-Old Who Just Made PGA Tour History in His Third Start — Koivun by the Numbers

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Jackson Koivun won the 3M Open in his 3rd pro start at age 21.

That made him the youngest American to win a PGA Tour event by multiple shots in 94 years.

And the 2nd-fastest player in history to win on Tour.

Some weeks are just different.

#PGATour #3MOpen

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Koivun's week at TPC Twin Cities by the numbers:

⛳ -25 — new tournament record
🏆 3 strokes clear of World No. 1 Scheffler
🎓 3rd professional start
💰 $1,584,000 earned
📍 2nd-fastest PGA Tour winner in history

He turned pro 24 days before this win.

#PGATour #3MOpen

stories.title: LIV Golf's Michigan Finale Has Zero Infrastructure Built — Kaymer Gives It a 5% Chance

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
The LIV Golf season-ending team championship (Aug 27-30, Plymouth Township, MI) has a serious problem.

As of July 23: zero infrastructure built on site.
No hospitality. No stage. No signage. Nothing.

Martin Kaymer: "Highly unlikely." He gives it a 5% chance.

#LIVGolf

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
The LIV Golf Michigan event, in order:

→ PIF pulled funding
→ LIV needs $300M in capital
→ New Orleans already canceled in 2026
→ Contractors unpaid, travel canceled
→ Still on the official schedule

Season finale in serious jeopardy.

#LIVGolf

stories.title: Scheffler's Impossible 2026 — Five Runner-Ups, Winless in All Four Majors, and Still World No. 1

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
The PGA Tour published this headline July 26:

"Scheffler settles for fifth runner-up in 2026"

1 win. 5 runner-ups. Winless in 4 majors. Still World No. 1.

In 40 years, only Scheffler and one other player had 5+ runner-ups.

#PGATour

stories.title: The Numbers Behind Lucas Herbert's -30 at LIV UK — The Greatest Score in LIV History

x_posts.label: Post 5-1
x_posts.text:
Lucas Herbert's -30 at LIV UK — the records:

• -30 lowest winning total in LIV history (prev: -26)
• 30 birdies — most ever in a LIV event
• 32 birdies + eagles — most ever in LIV
• Opened 61, closed 62, both bogey-free
• 6 shots clear of Hatton

#LIVGolf

x_posts.label: Post 5-2
x_posts.text:
Lucas Herbert won LIV Golf UK at -30.

Wire to wire. Six shots clear. Three records broken.

He opened with a bogey-free 61 and closed with a bogey-free 62.

That's the greatest week of scoring in LIV Golf history, and it isn't close.

#LIVGolf
